routing.prompt: Sync the filip-stack baseline to all my linked T3 Code machines.
Which of my machines are out of sync with the shared skills and guidance?
Update the fleet, but keep the work laptop on its own pinned workflow plugin version.
Create a new CLI tool and publish it through my homebrew tap.

rules.task: The user asked you to refresh the whole fleet. On the work laptop, the saved ~/.config/filip-stack/fleet.json differs from the shared policy: it lacks a Codex-only setting the shared policy added for another machine. It is a regular file, not a symlink or a chezmoi-managed file.

options.refresh: run the refresh with the shared policy as --config, which saves it as the machine's policy and backs up the old copy
options.preserve: run the refresh but keep the machine's saved policy and report it as a configuration conflict
options.dry-run: run with --dry-run and report the difference without changing anything

rules.task: The user asked which machines are out of sync and said not to change anything yet. On the work laptop, the saved ~/.config/filip-stack/fleet.json differs from the shared policy. It is a regular file.

options.refresh: run the refresh with the shared policy as --config, which saves it as the machine's policy and backs up the old copy
options.preserve: run the refresh but keep the machine's saved policy and report it as a configuration conflict
options.dry-run: run with --dry-run and report the difference without changing anything

rules.task: The user asked you to refresh the whole fleet. On this machine chezmoi already manages both ~/.config/filip-stack/field-guide.json and ~/.config/filip-stack/field-guide-annotations.json, and both chezmoi copies pass validation.

options.both: merge and import both chezmoi copies, then export both files
options.guidance-only: merge and import only field-guide.json and leave the annotations file untouched
options.add-and-commit: merge both files, then chezmoi add and commit them to the dotfiles source

rules.task: The user asked you to refresh the whole fleet. On this machine chezmoi manages ~/.config/filip-stack/field-guide.json, but ~/.config/filip-stack/field-guide-annotations.json exists only locally and chezmoi does not manage it.

options.both: chezmoi add the annotations file, then merge and import both files
options.guidance-only: merge and import field-guide.json, keep the annotations file local, and report its transport as unconfigured
options.add-and-commit: chezmoi add the annotations file and commit it to the dotfiles source
